languageNotice: Language support is in progress. Some text appears in English.
welcomeBody: Tell your coach what you want to do. Choose a pause, a little access, or an agreement that helps you stop.
consentBody: To respond, OpenAI receives your messages, app names, intentions and notes, recent allocated access sessions, active grants, waits, agreements, optional recent check-ins and recent app-removal feedback. This is not measured app usage.
consentPrivacy: Your history is stored on this device. Each request sends the coaching context described above. You can withdraw sharing at any time in Privacy & Data, which cancels pending responses and offers.
screenTimeBody: Volition uses Apple’s Screen Time permission to shield only apps you choose. Your app selection stays on your device.
chatEmptyTitle:
A little intention.
A better next step.
chatEmptyBody: What brings you to {{app}}? Tell your coach what you have in mind.
chatEmptyCaption: A quick task. A little downtime. It all counts.
chatPromptWithoutApp: What would you like to do? Name an app in your message or choose one above.
chatPromptWithApp: What would you like to do in {{app}}?
chatNoMatchingApps: No saved apps match your search.
chatNoSavedApps: Save an app in Apps to ask for access here.
chatCancelled: Request cancelled. Your draft is saved.
chatPauseStillLocked: {{app}} stays locked until you choose to unlock it.
chatChoiceAccess_one: Each option offers {{count}} minute of access.
chatChoiceAccess_other: Each option offers {{count}} minutes of access.
chatNoNewBreak: Start now without a new break
chooseAppHint: Choose the app you mean. Your draft is saved.
composerPlaceholder: What would you like to do?
feedbackQuestion: How did that feel? Private and optional.
interrupted: This request was interrupted. Send a new request.
dealTerms: Deal: {{access}} minutes now, then {{rest}} minutes away
acceptTerms: Accept: {{access}} minutes now, then {{rest}} minutes away
appsEmptyBody: Add an app you’d like to use more thoughtfully. You can always change or remove it.
removeReasonPrompt: What made this feel unhelpful? Sharing a reason is optional and stays private.
removeAlternative: Would a little access help instead? You can ask the coach, or remove this app now.
minutesValidation: Enter a whole number from 1 to 60.
insightsSubtitle: A little perspective on your access.
editorChooseHelp: Choose the app you’d like to use more intentionally.
appNameHelp: Use the app’s actual name, for example SoundCloud.
nameRequired: Please give this app a name.
editorIntentionHelp: Think about when you want to use it, work you need to do, or how you’d like to scroll.
purposeQuestion: What do you want this app for?
changeQuestion: What would you like to change?
sessionQuestion: What kind of sessions work for you?
extraHelp: Optional notes can help your coach understand your intention.
recurringHelp: Set a regular time to protect your attention.
focusEmptyBody: Add a recurring period for work, rest, or anything that deserves your attention.
focusActiveHelp: Your focus session is active. You can end it whenever you need to.
startSessionHelp: Choose how long you’d like some space to focus.
protectedAppsHelp: Choose specific saved apps, or leave all apps selected to protect every app.
saveAppsFirst: Save apps in Apps to choose them individually.
toneFooter: Tone changes the coach’s style, not the rules for access.
apiKeyFooter: Your personal key is stored in Keychain. GPT-5.4 mini is used for coaching.
keyReplace: Enter a new key to replace it.
keyAdd: Add your personal API key to use the coach.
reminderFooter: Alerts at 60, 30 and 10 seconds remaining are best effort; system delivery can be delayed or unavailable.
privacySubtitle: Control what is shared and stored.
enableSharingBody: The information described above will be sent to OpenAI for coaching.
sharingFooter: Turning sharing off cancels pending coach responses and offers.
sharingOnDescription: On · coaching can use your context
whatSharedBody: Messages, saved app names, intentions, notes, recent allocated sessions, active unlocks and waits, agreements, recent app-removal feedback and optional check-ins are sent only while AI sharing is enabled.
googleDiagnosticsBody: Analytics shares device information and which Volition screens you visit with Google. Crash reports share crash details, device information and stack traces. Reports can contain information present in a crash. These choices are independent of AI sharing. Disabling crash reports takes full effect after restarting the app.
googleUnavailable: Google diagnostics are unavailable in this build.
onDeviceBody: Chat, private activity history, saved profiles and commitments remain local. Keys are kept in Keychain. Ratings never affect access.
eraseChatFooter: Activity logs, access history and accepted commitments are retained. Pending offers are cancelled.
eraseConfirm: Private activity logs, access history and existing agreements remain available. Pending offers are cancelled.
periodIntro: Create a recurring boundary for the time you want to protect.
timeHelp: Use 24-hour time. An end time before the start continues into the next day.
overnightHelp: Overnight periods begin on the selected day.
onboardingConsentIntro: Choose whether your coach can use AI. You can change your mind later.
onboardingDeviceBody: Your history and app selection are stored on this device.
onboardingControlBody: Turn sharing off anytime in Privacy & data. Pending replies and offers are cancelled; information already sent cannot be recalled.
onboardingConsentError: Your choice could not be saved. Please retry.
onboardingScreenTimeIntro: Screen Time lets Volition place a pause between you and the apps you choose.
onboardingPermissionDenied: Screen Time access was denied. Allow it in Settings, then return to Volition, or try again.
onboardingPermissionFailed: We couldn’t confirm Screen Time access. Try again or check Settings, then return here.
onboardingPermissionDismissed: The prompt was dismissed. You can try again whenever you’re ready.
onboardingFirstAppIntro: Choose an app and tell your coach what you want from it.
